notes: Round-4 findings were raised against the round-3 fix commit and are fixed here; both are now permanent selftest checks.

A further defect was found and fixed while addressing them: the byte-level pattern was encoded with the DETECTION codec, so 'utf-8-sig' prepended a BOM and the identifier was never matched in UTF-8/GB18030 files. The detection codec and the pattern codec are now separate.
The scrub now performs byte-level replacement and verifies that the written bytes equal the original with only the encoded identifier spans replaced, so malformed sequences elsewhere are untouched.
No AutoCAD, CoreConsole or debug adapter process was started.
